subject: The mistake your partner notices at 8PM
preview_text: Most couples make this error in their first week. Here's how to avoid it and keep the spark alive tonight.
body_paragraphs: Scrolling through your phone? That's the exact moment your partner feels invisible. The #1 mistake couples make isn't forgetting to plan a date — it's planning the wrong way. They spend 20 minutes searching for ideas, debating options, and somehow end up on the couch, annoyed. Meanwhile, the spark turns into a to-do list item that feels like a chore.

The fix is almost too simple. Couples who use Tonight's Date in their first 24 hours plan 4x more dates over the next month. Why? Because they stop overthinking. They tap one mood — cozy, adventurous, playful, healing — and in 30 seconds, the night is planned. No debate, no fatigue. Just a shared moment that says, I see you.

That's what SoulPlan does. Open the app, look at the home screen. You'll see a single AI-picked card waiting. Tap a mood, and your partner gets a full-screen 'thought of you tonight' moment — not a boring notification. It turns a quick decision into a gesture that builds your Memory Timeline, one date at a time.

Open SoulPlan now. Tap Tonight's Date and choose a mood. That's it. P.S. — The streak counter lets you pause a week without shame, so you never lose momentum. But tonight, don't pause. Just tap and feel the difference.
